scripts.text:
[Sweet Veronica]
Welcome to Veronica Beauty Salon, reborn as a world-class stylist. Hhhi.
scripts.translation:
[溫柔的 維羅妮卡]
歡迎光臨維羅妮卡美容沙龍！如今我可是世界級造型師了，嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Sweet Veronica]
Everyone has the right to be beautiful... I hope you find a style that suits you.
scripts.translation:
[溫柔的 維羅妮卡]
每個人都有追求美麗的權利...希望你能找到適合自己的造型。

scripts.text:
[Jovovich]
Welcome. I'm Jovovich, a famous stylist from Prontera. How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[喬沃維奇]
歡迎光臨。我是喬沃維奇，普隆德拉著名的造型師。有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

[喬沃維奇]
歡迎再次光臨~

scripts.text:
[Prince Shami]
I'm back as one of the greatest stylists in the world. I'm Prince Shami and a professional stylist and I have to say I've been blessed by this great talent! <3
scripts.translation:
[王子 沙米]
世界頂尖造型師回來了！我就是沙米王子，專業造型師！
不得不說，這份天賦真是上天的恩賜！<3

scripts.text:
[Prince Shami]
Are you saying you don't like this stylish? How is this possible!
scripts.translation:
[王子 沙米]
您是說，不喜歡這位造型師？怎麼可能！

scripts.text:
[Lonza]
If you're a Doram who lives and dies for fashion, trust me. To the beat of the music~
scripts.translation:
[隆扎]
為時尚而生、為時尚而死的多蘭，請相信我。
跟著音樂的節拍~

scripts.text:
[Lonza]
There is no such thing as bad weather, right? One day I want you to trust me.
I'm Lonza and I can give you an amazing change that will make you stylish, so come and visit me anytime.
scripts.translation:
[隆扎]
哪有什麼壞天氣呢，對吧？希望有一天您能信任我。
我是隆扎，能讓您煥然一新、走在時尚前沿，隨時來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Isop]
Hehe, Welcome. I'm Isop, the stylist of the <Shook Shook-Store>.
scripts.translation:
[伊索普]
嘿嘿，歡迎光臨。我是<唰唰造型店>的造型師伊索普。

[伊索普]
您想剪什麼髮型？

scripts.text:
[Maxi]
Nice to meet you my guest. Would you like to leave your transformation to Maxi, the best stylist in Schwarzwald?
scripts.translation:
[麥克西]
歡迎光臨，客人。
要不要把造型交給秀髮茲發德最棒的造型師麥克西？
